title: VCF Automation 9.1 deployment inventory and action contract

source.statement: This is a narrow, reference-derived contract built from the authoritative Broadcom xAPI reference documentation. VCF Automation is not represented by a published specification in vmware/vcf-api-specs.

transport.scheme: https on a live appliance; http on the verifier's loopback mock

operations.description: Fetch all deployments as a paginated collection.

query.page: optional integer, minimum 0, default 0; zero-based page index
query.size: optional integer, minimum 1, default 20; requested page size
query.sort: optional repeatable string in property,(asc|desc) form; default createdAt,DESC

requiredForClient.content[].name: deployment name
requiredForClient.last: true only for the final page

operations.description: Return the deployment request with the given ID.

requiredForClient.completedAt: optional date-time at which the request completed

clientScenario.outputOrder: Java String order by name, then id
clientScenario.note: The terminal classification and output ordering are requirements of this client scenario. The reference documents enumerate statuses but do not label a terminal subset.
